Vendored ArDoCo benchmark texts (one sentence per line).

teastore/teastore.txt
  source:  https://github.com/ArDoCo/Benchmark, teastore/text_2020/teastore.txt (HEAD e60ddb2676358048131178c925e86a5b33ec38f2);
           the pinned ArDoCo commit 0d1f22b11caf3a758e5d32e5d3b06020c15d7407 (core/tests-base/src/main/resources/benchmark) was not
           available locally, so the file was not compared against it.
  origin:  TeaStore wiki "Services" (https://web.archive.org/web/20201102180945/https://github.com/DescartesResearch/teastore/wiki/Services)
  license: Apache-2.0 (TeaStore, https://github.com/DescartesResearch/TeaStore); see the benchmark README of text_2020.

mediastore/mediastore.txt
  source:  https://github.com/ArDoCo/Benchmark, mediastore/text_2016/mediastore.txt (HEAD e60ddb2676358048131178c925e86a5b33ec38f2), unmodified.
  origin:  book "Modeling and Simulating Software Architectures: The Palladio Approach" (https://books.google.de/books?id=g6BSDQAAQBAJ).
  license: none stated for the text in the benchmark; vendored by decision of the repository owner (2026-10-09), see mediastore/NOTICE.

TeaStore was taken from Benchmark HEAD e60ddb2, not from the pinned ArDoCo commit.

Vendored ArDoCo benchmark models (T1.2); MIT license, see LICENSE-Benchmark (covers models and gold standards).
The benchmark READMEs (teastore, mediastore) state no separate model license; the MIT note only says texts and diagrams follow
the upstream projects. teastore models describe the Apache-2.0 TeaStore and are listed in teastore/NOTICE as a precaution.
mediastore models describe the Palladio MediaStore example (Palladio Approach book); no model license is stated upstream beyond
the benchmark MIT license - provenance of that model is unclear and is reported, not resolved.
Taken unmodified from the ArDoCo/Benchmark repository, HEAD e60ddb2676358048131178c925e86a5b33ec38f2:
  mediastore/pcm/ms.repository     <- mediastore/model_2016/pcm/ms.repository
  mediastore/uml/ms.uml            <- mediastore/model_2016/uml/ms.uml
  teastore/pcm/teastore.repository <- teastore/model_2020/pcm/teastore.repository
  teastore/uml/teastore.uml        <- teastore/model_2020/uml/teastore.uml
Not compared against the pinned ArDoCo commit 0d1f22b (not available locally).

Added 2026-10-09 (M1 exit): TEAMMATES, BigBlueButton, JabRef, all from ArDoCo/Benchmark HEAD e60ddb2676358048131178c925e86a5b33ec38f2, unmodified:
  teammates/teammates.txt                          <- teammates/text_2021/teammates.txt
  teammates/pcm/teammates{,-with-details}.repository <- teammates/model_2021/pcm/
  teammates/uml/teammates{,-with-details}.uml      <- teammates/model_2021/uml/
  bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton.txt                  <- bigbluebutton/text_2021/bigbluebutton.txt
  bigbluebutton/pcm/bbb.repository, uml/bbb.uml    <- bigbluebutton/model_2021/{pcm,uml}/
  jabref/jabref.txt                                <- jabref/text_2021/jabref.txt
  jabref/pcm/jabref.repository, uml/jabref.uml     <- jabref/model_2021/{pcm,uml}/
Licenses (per the benchmark READMEs text_2021/README.md): texts follow the upstream project licence (TEAMMATES GPL-2.0,
BigBlueButton LGPL, JabRef MIT), see the NOTICE file in each project dir; models/gold standards are covered by the benchmark MIT
license (LICENSE-Benchmark). Code models (model_2023/code/codeModel.acm, 1.1-5.7 MB) are not vendored: no extractor reads them.
Gold standards (goldstandards/*.csv) are not vendored: no test uses them.
